title: Scotsman — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Scotsman.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Perfect Ice." Premium tier. Scotsman has been the ice machine specialist since 1950. Their residential undercounter ice makers produce nugget, cube, and gourmet ice. Known for the best nugget ice maker on the market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Home bars, outdoor kitchens, ice enthusiasts. The nugget ice crowd.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Scotsman:

• The best nugget ice maker on the market — period

• 70+ years of ice-making expertise

• Residential and commercial options

• Clear ice and gourmet cube models

• The ice machine bartenders recommend
